environment: **Organization**: Individual developer (GitHub user chenghung) working on personal projects and on projects of the employer org OnrampLab

**Source control**: Repos under github.com/OnrampLab are the employer trust domain; repos under github.com/chenghung are personal. Each is a trusted push and PR destination for its own work only. OnrampLab content (code, docs, internal names) must not be copied or pushed into chenghung repos or any non-OnrampLab destination, and personal content must not be pushed into OnrampLab repos unless the user asks. Trust does not override visibility: a public repo in either namespace is still a public destination.

**Repository visibility**: OnrampLab/voice-fusion-backend and chenghung/eddie-obsidian-wiki are private. Other repos under github.com/chenghung are a mix of public and private: do not assume private for them.

**Org-specific CLIs**: these binaries are legitimate, but that does not pre-approve their write, publish or share operations. rtk is an output-compacting wrapper that a PreToolUse hook prepends (e.g. rg -> rtk rg); evaluate `rtk <cmd>` exactly as `<cmd>`. Local-only: codegraph (code index queries), mmdc (local mermaid rendering, no mermaid.ink upload), herdr (local terminal multiplexer for coding agents), openspec (local spec-file workflow). Remote-writing: hackmd-cli (hackmd.io notes, may be publicly shared) and trello (Trello cards and comments) are judged under the normal publication and external-write rules.

**Host containment**: ordinary Manjaro developer machine with open internet. Each git worktree under .claude/worktrees/ gets its own isolated local Docker Compose stack; those stacks and their volumes and databases are disposable (e.g. docker compose down -v inside a .claude/worktrees/* checkout is fine). The stack of a primary checkout (repo root, not under .claude/worktrees/) holds data the user wants to keep: deleting its volumes or databases is irreversible local destruction. None of these stacks is production.
